prompt: Create a high-quality vertical outdoor portrait photograph of a young South Asian man with short black hair parted to the side, medium warm-brown skin, thick eyebrows, dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and mustache. He is seated casually on an ornate black wrought-iron garden bench, facing the camera with a calm, neutral expression. He wears a dark chocolate-brown traditional shalwar kameez with a collared button-up tunic and matching loose trousers. Include exactly 3 visible accessories: a gold wristwatch on his right wrist, a silver ring on his left hand, and a thin black bracelet on his left wrist. Pose him with one arm resting along the bench back, the other hand relaxed near his knee, one leg bent and the other extended slightly, wearing brown leather sandals. Set the scene in a lush garden during golden hour, with warm sunlight filtering through trees and a canopy of bougainvillea flowers hanging overhead. The flowers should include exactly 3 prominent color groups: bright pink, pale pink, and creamy white blossoms, with green leaves surrounding them. Use shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, soft backlighting, natural skin texture, realistic proportions, and a premium DSLR portrait look. Composition should be tall 9:16, subject centered in the lower half, floral canopy filling the upper third, no text, no watermark, no exaggerated retouching.

promptZh: 创作一张高质量的竖构图户外人像摄影作品，拍摄对象是一位年轻的南亚男性，拥有 侧分黑色短发，肤色呈中等暖棕色，眉毛浓密，深色双眸，留着修剪整齐的短胡须。他随意地坐在装饰精美的黑色锻铁花园长椅上，面朝镜头，表情平静自然。他身穿一套 深巧克力棕色 的传统沙尔瓦卡米兹（shalwar kameez），上衣为翻领纽扣式长袍，搭配宽松长裤。画面中需包含 3 个清晰可见的配饰：右手佩戴一块金表，左手佩戴一枚银戒指，左手腕佩戴一条黑色细手链。姿势要求：一只手臂靠在长椅靠背上，另一只手自然放松于膝盖附近，一条腿弯曲，另一条腿微微伸展，脚穿棕色皮凉鞋。场景设定在黄金时刻的茂密花园中，温暖的阳光透过树木洒下，头顶上方覆盖着三角梅花冠。花朵应包含 3 种鲜明的色调：亮粉色、浅粉色和奶油白色，周围环绕着绿叶。采用浅景深、奶油般虚化的背景、柔和的逆光、自然的皮肤纹理、写实的比例，呈现高端 DSLR 人像质感。构图比例为 9:16 的竖幅，主体位于下半部分中心，花卉花冠填满上方三分之一区域，无文字，无水印，无过度修图。
